description: CR 115.1 / 603.3d / 608.2h Necrotic Plague: the dead creature's controller chooses a creature one of their opponents controls, and the Plague returns under its own controller's control attached to it
note: Alice's Plague enchants bob's Bears, so the granted trigger sacrifices them on bob's upkeep. Bob, the Bears' controller by last-known information, announces the target of alice's trigger: an engine asking alice raises an unscheduled prompt. His own Piker is refused, as it would be offered were the opponents alice's; alice's Giant and carol's Ogre are both offered, and he takes carol's. The Plague comes back under alice, not bob, attached to the Ogre.
